question: Which of the following is a plant hormone?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा पादप हार्मोन है?
solution:
The correct answer is Cytokinin.

Key Points

  • Cytokinin is the plant hormone.
  • Cytokinin has a major role in the growth and development of plants. 
  • Cytokinin helps in cell growth in the apical region and leaf senescence.
  • Cytokinins are important signalling molecules that regulate the growth and development throughout the life of the plant.

Important Points

  • Cytokinins were discovered by F. Skoog, C. Miller.
  • Insulin was discovered by Sir Frederick G Banting, harles H Best and JJR Macleod at the University of Toronto in 1921

Additional Information

  • Insulin regulates the metabolism of carbohydrates, fats, and protein by promoting the absorption of glucose from the blood into the liver, fat, and skeletal muscle cells. 
  • Oestrogen is one of the main female sex hormones. 
  • Testosterone is the primary sex hormone and anabolic steroid in males.

question: The device which converts sound to electrical vibrations
question_hi: वह उपकरण जो ध्वनि को विद्युत कंपन में परिवर्तित करता है
solution:
The correct answer is Microphone.

Key Points

  • The microphone converts sound to electrical vibrations.
  • Microphones are used in many applications such as telephones, hearing aids, radio, and television broadcasting.
  • They are also used in computers for recording voice.
  • Microphones typically need to be connected to a preamplifier before the signal can be recorded or reproduced.

Additional Information

  • The microphone was invented by James Edward Maceo West in the 1870s.
  • An integrated circuit (IC) or monolithic integrated circuit is a set of electronic circuits on one small flat piece of semiconductor material, usually silicon. 
  • A stereoscope is a device for viewing a stereoscopic pair of separate images, depicting left-eye and right-eye views of the same scene, as a single three-dimensional image.

Additional Information

  • Govind Ballabh Pant argued that in order to become loyal citizens people had to stop focusing only on the community and the self.
  • Govind Ballabh Pant emphasized that one should be self-disciplined to make democracy successful.

Additional Information

  • Govind Ballabh Pant was the former Minister of Home Affairs in the Indian National Congress Government.
  • Govind Ballabh Pant was also awarded Bharat Ratna on 26 January 1957.
  • He was one of the foremost political leaders of Uttarakhand.

question: Area of the circle inscribed in a square of side 'a' cm is
question_hi: भुजा 'a' सेमी वाले वर्ग में निहित वृत्त का क्षेत्रफल है
solution:
Given

Side of square = a

Formula used

Area of circle = πr2

Calculation

Here side of the square is equal to the diameter of the circle

⇒ Radius = a/2

⇒ Area = π(a/2)2

∴ The area of circle inscribed in a square of side a is πa2/4
solution_hi:
दिया गया है

वर्ग की भुजा = a

प्रयुक्त सूत्र

वृत्त का क्षेत्रफल = πr2

गणना

यहाँ वर्ग की भुजा वृत्त के व्यास के बराबर है

⇒ त्रिज्या = a/2

⇒ क्षेत्रफल = π(a/2)2

∴ भुजा a सेमी वाले वर्ग में निहित वृत्त का क्षेत्रफल πa2/4 है।

question: A and B are friends and B is 2 years younger than A. A's father D is twice as old as A and B is twice as his sister C. The age of D and C differ by 40 years. The ages of 'A' and 'B' are respectively
question_hi: A और B मित्र हैं और B, A से 2 वर्ष छोटा है। A के पिता D की आयु A से दोगुनी है और B की आयु अपनी बहन C से दोगुनी है। D और C की आयु में 40 वर्ष का अंतर है। 'A' और 'B' की आयु क्रमशः क्या है
solution:
Given:

B is 2 years younger than A,

A's father D is twice as old as A,

B is twice as his sister C,

The age of D and C differ by 40 years.

Calculation:

According to the question,

B is 2 years younger than A,

⇒ B = A - 2      ----(1) 

A's father D is twice as old as A,

⇒ D = 2A      ----(2)

B is twice as his sister C,

⇒ B/2 = C      ----(3)

The age of D and C differ by 40 years, 

⇒ D - C = 40      ----(4)

Now substitute (2) & (3) in equation (4)

⇒ 2A - (B/2) = 40

⇒ 4A - B = 40 × 2

⇒ 4A - B = 80      ----(5)

Now (5) - (1)

⇒ 3A = 78

⇒ A = 26 

Now substitute Value of A in (1)

⇒ B = 26 - 2

⇒ B = 24

∴ The ages of 'A' and 'B' are 26 yrs & 24 yrs respectively.
solution_hi:
दिया गया है:

B, A से 2 वर्ष छोटा है,

A के पिता D की आयु A से दोगुनी है,

B की आयु अपनी बहन C से दोगुनी है,

D और C की आयु में 40 वर्ष का अंतर है।

गणना:

प्रश्न के अनुसार,

B, A से 2 वर्ष छोटा है,

⇒ B = A - 2      ----(1) 

A के पिता D की आयु A से दोगुनी है,

⇒ D = 2A      ----(2)

B की आयु अपनी बहन C से दोगुनी है,

⇒ B/2 = C      ----(3)

D और C की आयु में 40 वर्ष का अंतर है,

⇒ D - C = 40      ----(4)

अब समीकरण (4) में (2) और (3) को रखने पर 

⇒ 2A - (B/2) = 40

⇒ 4A - B = 40 × 2

⇒ 4A - B = 80      ----(5)

अब (5) - (1)

⇒ 3A = 78

⇒ A = 26 

अब (1) में A का मान रखने पर 

⇒ B = 26 - 2

⇒ B = 24

∴ 'A' और 'B' की आयु क्रमशः 26 वर्ष और 24 वर्ष हैं।

question: Mahabharata war was fought during

question: The potential difference between 2 points in a current carrying conductor when 1 joule of work is done to move a charge of 1 coulomb from one point to the other is
question_hi: किसी धारावाही चालक में 2 बिंदुओं के बीच विभवान्तर कितना होता है, जब 1 कूलम्ब आवेश को एक बिंदु से दूसरे बिंदु तक ले जाने के लिए 1 जूल कार्य किया जाता है।
solution:
The correct answer is 1 volt.

Key Points

  • One volt is the potential difference between two points in a current-carrying conductor when 1 joule of work is done to move a charge of 1 coulomb from one point to the other.
  • The unit of Potential difference is Volt.
  • The potential difference is measured by an instrument called a voltmeter. 

  • The first digital voltmeter was invented and produced by Andrew Kay of Non-Linear Systems (and later founder of Kaypro) in 1954.
  • Ampere is the SI unit of current.
  • Ohm is the unit of Resistance.
  • Newton is the unit of Force.

Additional Information

  • Resistance is a measure of the opposition to current flow in an electrical circuit.
  • A force is any interaction that, when unopposed, will change the motion of an object.  
  • One Ampere represents a flow of one coulomb of electrical charge per second.
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर 1 वोल्ट है।

Key Points

  • एक वोल्ट किसी धारावाही चालक में दो बिंदुओं के बीच का विभवान्तर है जब 1 कूलम्ब आवेश को एक बिंदु से दूसरे बिंदु तक ले जाने के लिए 1 जूल कार्य किया जाता है।
  • विभवान्तर का मात्रक वोल्ट है।
  • विभवान्तर को वोल्टमीटर नामक उपकरण द्वारा मापा जाता है।

  • पहले डिजिटल वाल्टमीटर का आविष्कार और निर्माण गैर-रैखिक प्रणालियों के एंड्रयू के (और बाद में केप्रो के संस्थापक) ने 1954 में किया था।
  • धारा का एसआई मात्रक एम्पीयर है।
  • प्रतिरोध का मात्रक ओम है।
  • बल का मात्रक न्यूटन है।

Additional Information

  • प्रतिरोध विद्युत परिपथ में धारा प्रवाह के विपरीत का एक माप है।
  • बल किसी भी अन्योन्य क्रिया को कहते हैं, जो बिना विरोध के किसी वस्तु की गति को बदल देती है।
  • एक एम्पीयर प्रति सेकंड विद्युत आवेश के एक कूलम्ब के प्रवाह को दर्शाता है।

question: The High Court has the jurisdiction under Article 226 for the enforcement of
question_hi: अनुच्छेद 226 के अंतर्गत उच्च न्यायालय के पास किससे संबंधित प्रवर्तन हेतु अधिकार-क्षेत्र है।

Key Points

    • Habeas corpus
    • Mandamus
    • Prohibition
    • Quo warranto
    • Certiorari.
  • The phrase ‘for any other purpose’ refers to the enforcement of an ordinary legal right.
  • The high court can issue writs to any person, authority and government not only within its territorial jurisdiction but also outside its territorial jurisdiction if the cause of action arises within its territorial jurisdiction

Important PointsDescription of 5 writs:

Writ Description
Habeas corpus A writ of habeas corpus is used to bring a prisoner or other detainee before the court to determine if the person's imprisonment or detention is lawful.
Mandamus It is a judicial writ issued as a command to an inferior court or ordering a person to perform a public or statutory duty.
Prohibition This writ is often issued by a superior court to the lower court directing it not to proceed with a case that does not fall under its jurisdiction.
Quo warranto

It a writ or legal action requiring a person to show by what warrant an office or franchise is held, claimed, or exercised.
Certiorari A type of writ, by which an appellate court decides to review a case at its discretion.

question: If 'GIVE' is coded as 43, then 'TAKE' is coded as
question_hi: यदि 'GIVE' को 43 के रूप में कूटबद्ध किया जाता है, फिर 'TAKE' को इस प्रकार कूटबद्ध किया जाता है
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

To form the code of a word, the position values of each letter of a code as per the English alphabetical series is added as shown below:

G(7) + I(9) + V(22) + E(5) = 43

Similarly, 

T(20) + A(1) + K(11) + E(5) = 37

Hence, "37" is the code for the word TAKE.
solution_hi:
यहाँ अनुसरित किया गया स्वरूप है:

एक शब्द का कूटबद्ध करने के लिए, अंग्रेजी वर्णमाला श्रृंखला के अनुसार एक कूट के प्रत्येक अक्षर के स्थानीय मानों को नीचे दिखाया गया है:

G(7) + I(9) + V(22) + E(5) = 43

इसी तरह,

T(20) + A(1) + K(11) + E(5) = 37

question_hi: यदि \(\sec\theta=\dfrac{4}{\sqrt7}\) है, तब \(\sqrt{\dfrac{2 tan^2 \theta-cosec^2 \theta}{2cos^2\theta-cot^2 \theta}}\) का मान है
solution:
Given:

secθ = 4/√7

Formula used:

p2 + b2 = h2

secθ = h/b

tanθ = p/b

cosecθ = h/p

cosθ = b/h

cotθ = b/p

Where,

p = Perpendicular

b = Base

h = Hypotenous

Calculation:

secθ = 4/√7

According to formula, we have

h = 4 and b = √7

So, p2 + (√7)2 = 42

⇒ p2 = 16 - 7 

⇒ p = √9

⇒ p = 3

So, tanθ = 3/√7

cosecθ = 4/3

cosθ = (√7)/4

cotθ = (√7)/3

So. √{(2tan2θ - cosec2θ)/(2cos2θ - cot2θ)}

⇒  √[{2 × (3/√7)2 - (4/3)2}/{2 × (√7/4)2 - (√7/3)2}]

⇒ √[{(18/7) - (16/9)}/{(14/16) - (7/9)}]

⇒ √[{(162 - 112)/63}/{(126 - 112)/144}]

⇒ √{(50/63)/(14/144)}

⇒ √{(50 × 144)/(63 × 14)}

⇒ √(400/49)

⇒ √(20/7)2

⇒ 20/7

∴ The value of √{(2tan2θ - cosec2θ)/(2cos2θ - cot2θ)} is 20/7.

question: If 15<sup>th</sup> of August was Wednesday, then 1<sup>st</sup> August of the same year was
question_hi: यदि 15 अगस्त को बुधवार था, तो उसी वर्ष 1 अगस्त को क्या था?
solution:
It is given that the 15th of August was a Wednesday.

There are 15 days from 1st August to 15th August.

On every 8th day, days of the week repeat.

Therefore, on 8th August = Wednesday.

Similarly on 1st of August = Wednesday

Hence, 1st August will be a "Wednesday".
solution_hi:
यह दिया गया है कि 15 अगस्त को बुधवार था।

1 अगस्त से 15 अगस्त तक 15 दिन होते हैं।

प्रत्येक 8वें दिन, सप्ताह के दिन दोहराते हैं।

अत:, 8 अगस्त = बुधवार 

इसी प्रकार 1 अगस्त = बुधवार

अतः, 1 अगस्त को "बुधवार" होगा।

question: Which of the following form an AP?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन एक समान्तर श्रेणी बनाता है?
solution:
Concept used:

A sequence of numbers is called an arithmetic progression if the difference between any two consecutive terms is always same. 

Calculation:

In option 1, we have

Difference between 1st and 2nd term = 1 - 1 = 0

And, difference between 2nd and 3rd term = 2 - 1 = 1

Here, the difference between any two consecutive terms is not equal.

So, option 1 is not in AP.

In option 2, we have

Difference between 1st and 2nd term = 0.33 - 0.3 = 0.03

And, difference between 2nd and 3rd term = 0.333 - 0.33 = 0.003

Here, the difference between any two consecutive terms is not equal.

So, option 2 is not in AP.

Now, in option 3, we have

Difference between 1st and 2nd term = 2 - √2 

⇒ 2 - 1.414

⇒ 0.586

And, difference between 2nd and 3rd term = 2√2 - 2

⇒ 2(1.414 - 1)

⇒ 2 × 0.414

⇒ 0.825

Here, the difference between any two consecutive terms is not equal.

So, option 3 is not in AP.

In option 4, we have

Difference between 1st and 2nd term = (3 + √2) - 3

⇒ √2

And, difference between 2nd and 3rd term = (3 + 2√2) - (3 + √2) 

⇒ √2

And, difference between 2nd and 3rd term = (3 + 2√2) - (3 + √2) 

⇒ √2

And, difference between 3nd and 4th term = (3 + 3√2) - (3 + 2√2) 

⇒ √2

∴ Option 4 is in AP.

question: Ms. X moves 20 metres ro the East and then turns to her left and walks 15 metres and then turns to her right and moves 25 metres. After this, she turns to her right and moves 15 metres. Now, how far is she from the starting point?
question_hi: मिस X पूर्व दिशा में 20 मीटर चलती है और फिर बाएं ओर मुड़ती है और 15 मीटर चलती है और फिर अपने दाएं मुड़ती है और 25 मीटर चलती है। इसके बाद, वह अपने दाएं ओर मुड़ती है और 15 मीटर चलती है। अब, वह प्रारंभिक बिंदु से कितनी दूर है?

question: _______ does not react with dilute HCI.
question_hi: _______ तनु HCI के साथ अभिक्रिया नहीं करता है।
solution:
The correct answer is Cu.

Key Points

  • Copper does not react with dilute HCI.
  • Copper has more reduction potential than Hydrogen which means that copper is less reactive than Hydrogen.
  • When copper is lower in reactivity series than hydrogen that means that it cannot displace the Hydrogen atom from non-oxidizing HCl.
  • Hence, Cu does not react with dilute HCl.

Additional Information

  • Dilute HCl is also known as non-oxidizing HCl.
  • When concentrated sulphuric acid is poured onto a copper plate, effervescence is observed.
  • The copper metal dissolves in hot concentrated sulphuric acid to form solutions containing the aquated Cu(II) ion together with hydrogen gas, H2.
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर Cu है।

Key Points

  • कॉपर (तांबा) तनु HCI के साथ अभिक्रिया नहीं करता है।
  • कॉपर (तांबा) में हाइड्रोजन की तुलना में अधिक अपचयन क्षमता होती है जिसका अर्थ है कि तांबा हाइड्रोजन की तुलना में कम प्रतिक्रियाशील होता है।
  • जब कॉपर (तांबा) हाइड्रोजन की तुलना में प्रतिक्रियाशीलता श्रृंखला में कम होता है, तो इसका मतलब है कि यह हाइड्रोजन परमाणु को गैर-ऑक्सीकरण एचसीएल से विस्थापित नहीं कर सकता है।
  • अतः, Cu तनु HCl के साथ अभिक्रिया नहीं करता है।

Additional Information

  • तनु सुल्फ्युरिक अम्ल को गैर-ऑक्सीकरण HCl के रूप में भी जाना जाता है।
  • जब सांद्र सल्फ्यूरिक अम्ल को तांबे की प्लेट पर डाला जाता है, तो बुदबुदाहट देखी जाती है।

question: Arrange the following structures of the atmosphere from the surface of the Earth.
question_hi: <font style="vertical-align: inherit;"><font style="vertical-align: inherit;">पृथ्वी की सतह से वायुमंडल की निम्नलिखित संरचनाओं को व्यवस्थित करें।</font></font>
options_hi: <font style="vertical-align: inherit;"><font style="vertical-align: inherit;">क्षोभमंडल - </font></font>मध्यमंडल<font style="vertical-align: inherit;"><font style="vertical-align: inherit;"> - समताप मंडल - </font></font>तापमंडल
<font style="vertical-align: inherit;"><font style="vertical-align: inherit;">क्षोभमंडल - समताप मंडल - मध्यमंडल - </font></font>तापमंडल
<font style="vertical-align: inherit;"><font style="vertical-align: inherit;">समताप मंडल - क्षोभमंडल - मध्यमंडल - </font></font>तापमंडल

<font style="vertical-align: inherit;"><font style="vertical-align: inherit;">समताप मंडल - </font></font>मध्यमंडल<font style="vertical-align: inherit;"><font style="vertical-align: inherit;"> - क्षोभमंडल - </font></font>तापमंडल
solution:
The correct answer is Troposphere - stratosphere - mesosphere - thermosphere.

Key Points

  • There are five layers in the structure of the atmosphere.
    • Troposphere
    • Stratosphere
    • Mesosphere
    • Thermosphere
    • Exosphere
  • Troposphere
    • It is considered the lowest layer of Earth’s atmosphere.
    • The troposphere starts at the surface of the earth and goes up to a height of 7 to 20 km.
    • All-weather occurs within this layer.
    • This layer has water vapor.
    • Temperature decreases at the rate of 1 degree Celsius for every 165 m of height.
    • Tropopause separates Troposphere and Stratosphere. 
  • Stratosphere
    • It is the second layer of the atmosphere found above the troposphere.
    • It extends up to 50 km in height.
    • This layer is very dry as it contains little water vapor.
    • This layer provides some advantages for flight because it is above stormy weather and has steady, strong, horizontal winds.
    • The ozone layer is found in this layer.
    • The ozone layer absorbs UV rays and safeguards the earth from harmful radiation.
    • Stratopause separates Stratosphere and Mesosphere. 
  • Mesosphere
    • It is the coldest of the atmospheric layers.
    • The mesosphere starts at 50 km above the surface of Earth and goes up to 85 km.
    • The temperature drops with altitude in this layer.
    • By 80 km it reaches -100 degrees Celsius.
    • Meteors burn up in this layer.
    • Mesopause separates Mesosphere and Thermosphere. 
  • Thermosphere
    • This layer is found above Mesopause from 80 to 400 km.
    • Radio waves that are transmitted from the earth are reflected by this layer.
    • The temperature increases with height.
    • Satellites occur in this layer.
  • Exosphere
    • It is the outermost layer of the atmosphere.
    • The zone where molecules and atoms escape into space is mentioned as the exosphere.
    • It extends from the top of the thermosphere up to 10,000 km.

    • ट्रोपोपॉज़ क्षोभमंडल और समताप मंडल को अलग करता है। 
  • समताप मंडल
    • यह क्षोभमंडल के ऊपर पाई जाने वाली वायुमण्डल की दूसरी परत है।

    • समताप सीमा समताप मंडल और मध्यमंडल को अलग करता है। 
  • मध्यमंडल
    • यह वायुमंडलीय परतों में सबसे ठंडी है।

  • तापमंडल
    • यह परत मध्यसीमा के ऊपर 80 से 400 किमी तक पाई जाती है।
    • पृथ्वी से प्रसारित होने वाली रेडियो तरंगें इस परत से परावर्तित होती हैं।

    • इस परत में उपग्रह होते हैं।
  • बहिर्मंडल
    • यह वायुमंडल की सबसे बाहरी परत है।
    • वह क्षेत्र जहां अणु और परमाणु अंतरिक्ष में पलायन करते हैं, को बहिर्मंडल कहा जाता है।
    • यह तापमंडल के शीर्ष से 10,000 किमी तक फैला हुआ है।

question: Which of the following statement/s is/are true regarding 97<sup>th</sup> Amendment of the Constitution?
question_hi: <font style="vertical-align: inherit;"><font style="vertical-align: inherit;">संविधान </font><font style="vertical-align: inherit;">के 97</font></font><sup><font style="vertical-align: inherit;"><font style="vertical-align: inherit;">वें</font></font></sup><font style="vertical-align: inherit;"><font style="vertical-align: inherit;"> संशोधन के </font><font style="vertical-align: inherit;">संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा/से कथन सत्य है/हैं </font><font style="vertical-align: inherit;">?</font></font>
options: It made the right to form Self Help Group as a Fundamental Right
It has brought a new provision into the Part IV of the Constitution (Directive Principle of State Policy)
options_hi: <font style="vertical-align: inherit;"><font style="vertical-align: inherit;">इसने मौलिक अधिकार के रूप में स्वयं सहायता समूह बनाने के अधिकार को बनाया</font></font>
<font style="vertical-align: inherit;"><font style="vertical-align: inherit;">यह संविधान के भाग IV (राज्य नीति के निदेशक सिद्धांत) में एक नया प्रावधान लाया है।</font></font>
<font style="vertical-align: inherit;"><font style="vertical-align: inherit;">दोनों गलत हैं</font></font>
<font style="vertical-align: inherit;"><font style="vertical-align: inherit;">दोनों सही हैं</font></font>
solution:
The correct answer is It made the right to form Self Help Group as a Fundamental Right and ​It has brought a new provision into Part IV of the Constitution (Directive Principle of State Policy).

Key Points

  • The 97th Constitutional Amendment Act of 2011 gave constitutional status and protection to cooperative societies.
  • It aims to overcome all the problems faced by these societies and bring about an efficient way to manage them.
  • It aims at encouraging the economic activities of cooperatives which in turn will help rural India progress.
  • In this context, it made the following three changes in the Constitution:
    • It made the right to form cooperative societies a fundamental right (Article 19).
    • It included a new Directive Principle of State Policy on the promotion of cooperative societies (Article 43-B).
    • It added a new Part IX-B in the Constitution which is entitled “The Cooperative Societies” (Articles 243-ZH to 243-ZT).

Additional Information

  • India borrowed the DPSP from the Irish Constitution of 1937 which itself had borrowed it from the Spanish Constitution.
  • Further, the Government of India Act had some “instruments of Instructions” which became the immediate source of DPSP.
  • The fundamental rights and the directive principles find the common origin in the Sapru Report of 1945, which had divided the fundamental rights into two parts viz. Justifiable and non-justifiable rights.
  • While justifiable rights were incorporated in Part III; non-justifiable rights were incorporated as directive principles to the state without any guarantee to be enforced via court.
  • Thus, the directive principles are guidelines by the constitution to the state as defined in article 12 (central, state, local government, and bodies).
  • Basic idea is that the “state” should keep these principles while framing laws, policies, ordinances, etc.
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर इसने स्वयं सहायता समूह को मौलिक अधिकार के रूप में बनाने का अधिकार बनाया और इसने संविधान के भाग IV (राज्य नीति के निदेशक सिद्धांत) में एक नया प्रावधान लाया है।

Key Points

  • 2011 के 97वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम ने सहकारी समितियों को संवैधानिक दर्जा और संरक्षण दिया।
  • इसका उद्देश्य इन समाजों के सामने आने वाली सभी समस्याओं को दूर करना और उन्हें प्रबंधित करने का एक कुशल तरीका लाना है।
  • इसका उद्देश्य सहकारी समितियों की आर्थिक गतिविधियों को प्रोत्साहित करना है जो बदले में ग्रामीण भारत की प्रगति में मदद करेगा।
  • इस संदर्भ में, इसने संविधान में निम्नलिखित तीन परिवर्तन किए:
    • इसने सहकारी समितियों के गठन के अधिकार को मौलिक अधिकार बना दिया (अनुच्छेद 19)
    • इसमें सहकारी समितियों के प्रचार पर राज्य की नीति का एक नया निदेशक सिद्धांत (अनुच्छेद 43-बी) शामिल था।
    • इसने संविधान में एक नया भाग IX-B जोड़ा, जिसका शीर्षक है "सहकारी समितियाँ" (अनुच्छेद 243-ZH से 243-ZT)

Additional Information

  • भारत ने DPSP को 1937 के आयरिश संविधान से लिया था, जिसने स्वयं इसे स्पेनिश संविधान से लिया था।
  • इसके अलावा, भारत सरकार अधिनियम में कुछ "निर्देशों के उपकरण" थे जो डीपीएसपी का तत्काल स्रोत बन गए।
  • मौलिक अधिकार और निर्देशक सिद्धांत 1945 की सप्रू रिपोर्ट में समान मूल का पता लगाते हैं, जिसने मौलिक अधिकारों को दो भागों में विभाजित किया था। न्यायोचित और गैर न्यायोचित अधिकार।
  • जबकि न्यायोचित अधिकारों को भाग III में शामिल किया गया था; अदालत के माध्यम से लागू होने की गारंटी के बिना गैर-न्यायसंगत अधिकारों को राज्य के निदेशक सिद्धांतों के रूप में शामिल किया गया था।
  • इस प्रकार, निर्देशक सिद्धांत संविधान द्वारा राज्य के लिए दिशा-निर्देश हैं जैसा कि अनुच्छेद 12 (केंद्र, राज्य, स्थानीय सरकार और निकाय) में परिभाषित किया गया है।
  • मूल विचार यह है कि कानून, नीतियां, अध्यादेश आदि बनाते समय "राज्य" को इन सिद्धांतों का पालन करना चाहिए।

question: Panchayat Raj Act came into existence pursuant to _______ Constitutional Amendment Act.
question_hi: पंचायत राज अधिनियम _______ संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम के अनुसार अस्तित्व में आया।
solution:
The correct answer is 73rd.

Key Points

  • Panchayat Raj Act came into existence pursuant to the 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act.
  • Panchayat Raj Act was based on the recommendation of the Balwant Rai Mehta committee.
  • It came into force with effect from April 24, 1993.
  • The Constitution (73rd Amendment) Act, 1992 has added a new part IX consisting of 16 Articles and the Eleventh Schedule to the Constitution. 
  • The amendment provides for a three-tier Panchayat Raj System at the village, intermediate, and district levels.

Additional Information

Some important Amendments in the Constitution:

Amendment Acts Description
1st Amendment Act
  • It was made in 1951.
  • It amended Article 15(4).
  • The 9th Schedule was also added.
42nd Amendment Act
  • It was made in 1976.
  • It is also known as the Mini Constitution of India.
  • Fundamental Duties were also added.
  • It added 'SOCIALIST, SECULAR and INTEGRITY' in the Preamble.
44th Amendment Act
  • The Amendment aimed to undo several changes that had been made to the Constitution by the 42nd Amendment which had been enacted by the Indira Gandhi-led Indian National Congress during the Emergency.
61st Amendment Act
  • Reduced the age of voting from 21 to 18.

question: When baking powder is heated or mixed in water _______ is produced.

solution:

  • When baking powder is heated or mixed with water it evolves carbon dioxide gas which gets converted into sodium carbonate.
  • The chemical reaction is as followed:

  • When sodium hydrogen carbonate is dissolved in water, it slightly gets hydrolyzed.

47 × 2 + 1 = 95

95 × 2 + 1 = 191

question: The sum of digits of two digit number is 9. Also, nine times of this number is twice the number obtained by reversing the order of the digits of the number. Then the number is
question_hi: दो अंकों की संख्या के अंकों का योग 9 है। साथ ही, इस संख्या का नौ गुना, संख्या के अंकों के क्रम को उलटने पर प्राप्त संख्या का दोगुना है। तब संख्या है
solution:
Given:

The sum of digits of a two-digit number = 9

9 times of this number is twice the number formed by reversing the digits

Formula used:

If x and y are unit digit and tenth place digit of a two-digit number 

Then the number = 10y + x

Calculation:

Let x and y be unit digit and the tenth place digit of a two-digit number 

According to the formula, we have

The number = 10y + x

Now, we reverse the digits of the number

Then, unit digit = y and tenth place digit = x

The new number = 10x+ y

According to the question, we have

x + y = 9      ----(1)

And, 9(10y + x) = 2(10x + y)

⇒ 90y + 9x = 20x + 2y

⇒ 20x - 9x = 90y - 2y

⇒ 11x = 88y

⇒ x = 8y      ----(2)

Put the value of equation (2) in equation (1), we have

8y + y = 9

⇒ 9y = 9

⇒ y = 1      ----(3)

Put the value of equation (3) in equation (1), we have

x + 1 = 9

⇒ 9 - 1

⇒ 8

So the number = 10y + x

⇒ (10 × 1) + 8

⇒ 18

∴ The required number is 18.

Shortcut Trick

Go through the option and check which one satisfies the conditions of the question.

Here in option (1), the given number is 18.

Now. we reverse the digits,

New number = 81

Sum of digit = 1 + 8 = 9

Here 18 × 9 = 81 × 2 = 162

So, option (1) satisfies the condition of the question.

∴ The required number is 18.
solution_hi:
दिया गया है:

दो अंकों की संख्या के अंकों का योग = 9

इस संख्या का नौ गुना, संख्या के अंकों के क्रम को उलटने पर प्राप्त संख्या का दोगुना है

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

यदि x और y दो अंकों की संख्या के इकाई स्थान अंक और दहाई स्थान अंक हैं

तब संख्या = 10y + x

गणना:

माना x और y दो अंकों की संख्या के इकाई स्थान अंक और दहाई स्थान अंक हैं

सूत्र के अनुसार, हमारे पास है

संख्या = 10y + x

अब, हम संख्या के अंकों को उलट देते हैं

तब, इकाई अंक = y और दहाई अंक = x

नई संख्या = 10x+ y

प्रश्न के अनुसार, हमारे पास है

x + y = 9      ----(1)

और, 9(10y + x) = 2(10x + y)

⇒ 90y + 9x = 20x + 2y

⇒ 20x - 9x = 90y - 2y

⇒ 11x = 88y

⇒ x = 8y      ----(2)

समीकरण (2) का मान समीकरण (1) में रखने पर, हमारे पास है

8y + y = 9

⇒ 9y = 9

⇒ y = 1      ----(3)

समीकरण (3) का मान समीकरण (1) में रखने पर, हमारे पास है

x + 1 = 9

⇒ 9 - 1

⇒ 8

इसलिए संख्या = 10y + x

⇒ (10 × 1) + 8

⇒ 18

∴ अभीष्ट संख्या 18 है। 

Shortcut Trick

विकल्पों की जांच कीजिए और देखिए कि कौन-सा प्रश्न की शर्तों को पूरा करता है।

यहाँ विकल्प (1) में, दी गई संख्या 18 है।

अब, हम अंकों को उलट देते हैं,

नई संख्या = 81

अंकों का योग = 1 + 8 = 9

यहाँ 18 × 9 = 81 × 2 = 162

इसलिए, विकल्प (1) प्रश्न की शर्त को संतुष्ट करता है।

∴ अभीष्ट संख्या 18 है।

question: The distance between the point (a, b) and (-1, -b) are
question_hi: बिन्दुओं (a, b) और (-1, -b) के बीच की दूरी है
solution:
Given:

The two points are (a, b) and (-1, -b)

Formula used:

Distance between two points (p, q) and (r, s) = √{(r - p)2 + (s - q)2}

Calculation:

According to the formula, we have

Distance between two points (a, b) and (-1, -b) = √{(-1 - a)2 + (-b - b)2}

⇒ √[{(-1)2 - 2 × (-1) × a + (a)2} + (-2b)2]

⇒ √(1 + 2a + a2 + 4b2)

∴ The distance between the point (a, b) and (-1, -b) is √(1 + 2a + a2 + 4b2).
solution_hi:

दो बिंदु (a, b) और (-1, -b) हैं

गणना:

सूत्र के अनुसार, हमारे पास है

दो बिन्दुओं(a, b) और (-1, -b) के बीच की दूरी = √{(-1 - a)2 + (-b - b)2}

⇒ √[{(-1)2 - 2 × (-1) × a + (a)2} + (-2b)2]

⇒ √(1 + 2a + a2 + 4b2)

∴ बिन्दुओं (a, b) और (-1, -b) के बीच की दूरी √(1 + 2a + a2 + 4b2) है।

question: If the equations x - 2y = 3 and 2x + by = 6 represent the same line, then the value of b is

solution:
Given:

The equations x - 2y = 3 and 2x + by = 6 are colinear,

Concept used:

If two equation ax + by = c and a1x + b1y = c1 are colinear, then (a/a1) = (b/b1) = (c/c1)

Calculation:

According to the concept, we have

(1/2) = (-2/b) = (3/6)

⇒ b = 2 × (-2)

⇒ -4

∴ The value of b is -4.

समीकरण x - 2y = 3 और 2x + by = 6 समरेखीय हैं,

यदि दो समीकरण ax + by = c और a1x + b1y = c1 समरेखीय होते हैं, तब (a/a1) = (b/b1) = (c/c1)

गणना:

अवधारणा के अनुसार, हमारे पास है 

(1/2) = (-2/b) = (3/6)

⇒ -4

∴ b का मान -4 है।

question: If P(E) = 0.05, what is the probability of 'not E'?
solution:
Given:

The Probability of E is given P(E) = 0.05

Concept used:

As we know that the sum of the probabilities of all the elementary events of an experiment is 1

Calculations:

According to the question, we have

The sum of probabilities of all the elementary events of an experiment is 1

Now, An experiment has two elementary events say E and not E then,

⇒ P(E) + P(not E) = 1

⇒ 0.05 + P(not E) = 1

⇒ P(not E) = 1 - 0.05

⇒ P(not E) = 0.95

∴ The probability of not E i.e., P(not E) is 0.95.

E की प्रायिकता दी गई है P(E) = 0.05

जैसा कि हम जानते हैं कि किसी प्रयोग की सभी प्रारंभिक घटनाओं की प्रायिकताओं का योग 1 होता है।

question: Three cubes each of side 2.5 cm are joined end to end, the total surface area of resulting solid is
question_hi: 2.5 सेमी भुजा वाले तीन घनों को एक सिरे से दूसरे सिरे तक जोड़ा जाता है, परिणामी ठोस का कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल है
solution:
Given:

Three cubes are given.

Side of each cube is 2.5 cm

Formula used:

Total surface area of cuboid = 2(lb + bh + hl)

Where, 

l is Length

b is Breadth

h is Height

Calculations:

According to the question, we have

If we join the three cubes, then its length will be three times of side of the cube

⇒ l = 3 × Side of cube

⇒ l = 3 × 2.5

⇒ l = 7.5 cm

And, the breadth and height will be same as the side of the cube

Total surface area of cuboid = 2(lb + bh + hl)

⇒ 2(7.5 × 2.5 + 2.5 × 2.5 + 2.5 × 7.5)

⇒ 2(18.75 + 6.25 + 18.75)

⇒ 2(43.75)

⇒ 87.50 cm2

∴ The total surface area of cuboid is 87.50 cm2.

question: The war of Kurukshetra was narrated to Dhritarashtra by
question_hi: <font style="vertical-align: inherit;"><font style="vertical-align: inherit;">कुरुक्षेत्र का युद्ध धृतराष्ट्र को किसके द्वारा सुनाया गया था</font></font>
solution:
The correct answer is Sanjaya.

Key Points

  • The war of Kurukshetra was narrated to Dhritarashtra by Sanjaya.
  • Sanjaya was telling Dhritarashtra everything that was taking place in the battlefield without leaving even the smallest events in the order of their occurrence.
  • Sanjaya was able to do this because of the boon granted by Vyasa.
    • When the armies of the Kauravas and the Pandavas pitched their camps on either side of the battlefield, Veda Vyasa came to Hastinapura and saw Dhritarashtra.
    • Dhritarashtra heard about the preparations on either side for the battle. He did not like to go to the battlefield and see for himself the events of the battle. He said so to Vyasa. Then Vyasa called Sanjaya to him and said "Sanjaya shall see all the events of the battle directly. 
    • He will tell you everything about the battle. He will be knowing all. Whenever he thinks of it he will see everything that takes place in the day and in the night in open, and in secret. No weapon will cut him and no weariness will affect him. He is the son of Gavalgana and will come away unhurt from the battle." (Bhishma Parva, Mahabharata). 
    • During the war, Sanjaya had the unpleasant duty of breaking the news to Dhritarashtra, of the fall of all his army commanders in chiefs (Bhishma, Drona, Karna, and Shalya) as well as the death of Dhritarashtra’s hundred sons at the hands of Bhima at different points of time in the battle, and offers the sorrowing king solace in his darkest hours. 

Additional Information

  • The entire Bhagavad Gita is Sanjay's recital to Dhritarashtra of the conversation between Arjuna and Krishna.
  • Sanjaya was the first person apart from Arjuna to listen to the Gita.

question: If 2 is a zero of polynomial f(x) = ax2 - 3(a - 1)x - 1, then value of a is
question_hi: यदि बहुपद f(x) = ax2 - 3(a - 1)x - 1 का एक शून्यक 2 है, तब a का मान है:
solution:
Given:

A polynomial is given f(x) = ax2 - 3(a - 1)x - 1

Zeroes of a polynomial is 2

Calculations:

According to the question, we have

f(x) = ax2 - 3(a - 1)x - 1

2 is zero of polynomial

⇒ f(2) = a(2)2 - 3(a - 1)2 - 1

⇒ 4a - 6(a - 1) - 1 = 0

⇒ 4a - 6a + 6 -1 = 0

⇒ 5 - 2a = 0

⇒ -2a = -5

⇒ 2a = 5

⇒ a = 5/2 

∴ If 2 is zero of a polynomial, then the value of a = 5/2.

solution:
The correct answer is These are plants growing in soil with optimum soil water conditions prevailing for major part of the year.

Key Points

  • Mesophytes are plants growing in soil with optimum soil water conditions prevailing for major part of the year.
  • They are terrestrial plants that are neither adapted to particularly dry nor particularly wet environments.
  • They grow in moderate climate.
  • Most of the cultivated plants belong to this category. Example: mango, orange, guava etc. 
  • Mesophytic Adaptations are:
    • Roots are well developed.
    • Stems are solid and freely branched.
    • Leaves are large, broad, and thin.
    • Stomata are present.
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर ये ऐसे पौधे हैं जो मिट्टी में उगते हैं और वर्ष के अधिकांश भाग के लिए इष्टतम मिट्टी की पानी की स्थिति होती है है।

  • वे स्थलीय पौधे हैं जो न तो विशेष रूप से सूखे और न ही विशेष रूप से गीले वातावरण के अनुकूल होते हैं।
  • वे मध्यम जलवायु में बढ़ते हैं।
  • अधिकांश खेती वाले पौधे इसी श्रेणी के हैं। उदाहरण: आम, संतरा, अमरूद आदि।

question: Who among the following leaders moved "Objective Resolution" in the Constitutional Assembly?
question_hi: <font style="vertical-align: inherit;"><font style="vertical-align: inherit;">निम्नलिखित में से किस नेता ने संवैधानिक सभा में "उद्देश्य प्रस्ताव" पेश किया?</font></font>

<font style="vertical-align: inherit;"><font style="vertical-align: inherit;">डॉ. बी. आर. अम्बेडकर</font></font>
solution:
The correct answer is Jawaharlal Nehru.

Key Points

  • The Objective Resolution was moved on December 13, 1946, by Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru, which provided the philosophy and guiding principles for framing the Constitution and later took the form of Preamble of the Constitution of India.
  • This Resolution was unanimously adopted by the Constituent Assembly on 22 January 1947.
    • It laid down the fundamentals and philosophy of the constitutional structure.
    • It influenced the eventual shaping of the constitution through all its subsequent stages.
    • Its modified version forms the Preamble of the present Constitution.

Additional Information

  • Dr. B. R. Ambedkar-
    • Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar, also known as Babasaheb Ambedkar, was an Indian scholar, jurist, economist, politician, and social reformer, who inspired the Dalit Buddhist movement and campaigned against social discrimination towards the untouchables, while also supporting the rights of women and labor.
  •  Dr. Rajendra Prasad 
    • He was an Indian independence activist, lawyer, scholar, and subsequently, the first President of India, in office from 1950 to 1962.
    • He was an Indian political leader and lawyer by training. 
  • Vallabhbhai Jhaverbhai Patel,
    • He was popularly known as Sardar Patel and was an Indian politician.
    • He served as the First Deputy Prime Minister of India.
solution_hi:
सही उत्‍तर जवाहरलाल नेहरू है। 

Key Points

  • उद्देश्य प्रस्ताव 13 दिसंबर, 1946 को पंडित जवाहरलाल नेहरू द्वारा पेश किया गया था, जिसने दर्शन और संविधान तैयार करने के लिए मार्गदर्शक सिद्धांत प्रदान किया और बाद में भारत के संविधान के प्रस्तावना के रूप ले लिया।
  • इस प्रस्ताव को 22 जनवरी 1947 को संविधान सभा द्वारा सर्वसम्मति से स्वीकार किया गया था।
    • इसने संवैधानिक संरचना के मूल सिद्धांतों और दर्शन को निर्धारित किया।
    • इसने अपने सभी बाद के चरणों के माध्यम से संविधान के अंतिम आकार को प्रभावित किया।
    • इसका संशोधित संस्करण वर्तमान संविधान की प्रस्तावना का निर्माण करता है।

Additional Information

  • डॉ बीआर अम्बेडकर -

  • डॉ राजेंद्र प्रसाद

question: 5000 years old Indus valley civilization, found in the present-day _______ District.
question_hi: 5000 साल पुरानी सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता, वर्तमान में _______ जिले में स्थित है।
solution:
The correct answer is Hisar.

 

  • Rakhigarhi archaeological site in Hisar district is about to rewrite the 5000-year-old history of our civilization. 
  • It is situated on the bank of the now dry, Saraswati river.
  • It is the largest Harappan site in the Indian subcontinent.
  • At Rakhigarhi, the excavations are being done to trace its beginnings and to study its gradual evolution from 6000 BCE (Pre-Harappan phase) to 2500 BC.
  • Other large sites of Harappan civilization on the Indian sub-continent are:
    • Harappa
    • Mohenjodaro
    • Ganveriwala in Pakistan
    • Dholavira (Gujarat) in India.

सही उत्तर हिसार है।

Key Points

  • हिसार जिले में राखीगढ़ी पुरातात्विक स्थल हमारी सभ्यता के 5000 साल पुराने इतिहास को फिर से लिखने वाला है।

question: An object 4 cm in size, is placed at 20 cm in front of a concave mirror of focal length 10 cm. At what distance from the mirror should a screen be placed in order to obtain a sharp image?
question_hi: 4 सेमी आकार की एक वस्तु को 10 सेमी फोकस दूरी वाले अवतल दर्पण के सामने 20 सेमी की दूरी पर रखा गया है। स्पष्ट प्रतिबिम्ब प्राप्त करने के लिए पर्दे को दर्पण से कितनी दूरी पर रखना चाहिए?
solution:
The correct answer is 20 cm from the mirror.

Key Points

Here, 

Focal length = f = -10,

Object Distance = u = -20,

Image Distance = v = ?

Mirror formula: 

⇒1/f = 1/u +1/v

⇒1/-10 = 1/-20 + 1/v

⇒1/v = -1/20

Hence, the distance of the image is equalled to 20 cm from the mirror.

 

  • This minus sign indicates that the image is real, inverted, and magnified. 
  • Magnification = m = -v/u

question: The force that blood exerts against the wall of a vessel is called

solution:
The correct answer is Systolic pressure.

Key Points

  • Blood pressure is the force of the blood pushing against the artery walls. 
  • The force is made with each heartbeat as blood is pumped from the heart into the blood vessels. This is called systolic blood pressure.
  • The components of blood pressure include systolic pressure, which results from ventricular contraction, and diastolic pressure, which results from ventricular relaxation.
  • Pulse pressure is the difference between systolic and diastolic measures, and mean arterial pressure is the “average” pressure of blood in the arterial system, driving blood into the tissues.

​Additional Information

  • When the heart is relaxed, the arteries stay at a lower resting tone to maintain some pressure in the artery. This is called diastolic blood pressure. 
  • Hemodialysis is a procedure where a dialysis machine and a special filter called an artificial kidney, or a dialyzer, are used to clean your blood.

question: The values of x and y satisfying the equation \(2\left(\dfrac{x}{a}\right)+\dfrac{y}{b}=2\:and\:\dfrac{x}{a}-\dfrac{y}{b}=4\) are
question_hi: समीकरण \(2\left(\dfrac{x}{a}\right)+\dfrac{y}{b}=2\:and\:\dfrac{x}{a}-\dfrac{y}{b}=4\) को संतुष्ट करने वाले x और y के मान हैं:
solution:
Given:

Two equations are given

\(2\left(\dfrac{x}{a}\right)+\dfrac{y}{b}=2\:and\:\dfrac{x}{a}-\dfrac{y}{b}=4\)

Calculations:

According to the questions, we have

2(x/a) + (y/b) = 2      ----(1)

(x/a) - (y/b) = 4      ----(2)

Multiply the equation (2) by 2 and subtracting from equation (1), we get

⇒ (2x/a) - (2y/b) -(2x/a) - (y/b) = 8 - 2

⇒ -3y/b = 6

⇒ y = -2b

Put y = -2b in equation (2), we get

⇒ (x/a) - (-2b/b) = 4

⇒ (x/a) = 4 - 2

⇒ x = 2a

∴ The value of x and y is 2a and -2b.

We can also solve this question through the option elimination method:

Let us consider option (1)

Put x = a and y = b in equations (1), we get

2(x/a) + (y/b) = 2

⇒ 2 + 1 ≠  2

⇒ 3 ≠ 2

Now, Let us consider option (2)

Put x = 2a and y = -2b in equations (1), we get

2(x/a) + (y/b) = 2

⇒ 4 - 2 =  2

⇒ 2 = 2

And, Put x = 2a and y = -2b in equations (2), we get

(x/a) - (y/b) = 4

⇒ 2 + 2 = 4

⇒ 4 = 4

Thus, Option (2) satisfies the both equation.

∴ The value of x and y is 2a and -2b.
solution_hi:
दिया गया है:

दो समीकरण दिए गए हैं

\(2\left(\dfrac{x}{a}\right)+\dfrac{y}{b}=2\:and\:\dfrac{x}{a}-\dfrac{y}{b}=4\)

गणना:

प्रश्न के अनुसार, हमारे पास है

2(x/a) + (y/b) = 2      ----(1)

(x/a) - (y/b) = 4      ----(2)

समीकरण (2) को 2 से गुणा करने पर और समीकरण (1) से घटाने पर, हम प्राप्त करते हैं

⇒ (2x/a) - (2y/b) -(2x/a) - (y/b) = 8 - 2

⇒ -3y/b = 6

⇒ y = -2b

समीकरण (2) में y = -2b रखने पर, हम प्राप्त करते हैं

⇒ (x/a) - (-2b/b) = 4

⇒ (x/a) = 4 - 2

⇒ x = 2a

∴ x और y के मान 2a और -2b हैं। 

हम इस प्रश्न को विकल्प उन्मूलन विधि के माध्यम से भी हल कर सकते हैं:

विकल्प (1) पर विचार करते हैं

समीकरण (1) में x = a और y = b रखने पर, हम प्राप्त करते हैं

2(x/a) + (y/b) = 2

⇒ 2 + 1 ≠  2

⇒ 3 ≠ 2

विकल्प (2) पर विचार करते हैं

समीकरण (1) में x = 2a और y = -2b रखने पर, हम प्राप्त करते हैं

2(x/a) + (y/b) = 2

⇒ 4 - 2 =  2

⇒ 2 = 2

और, समीकरण (2) में x = 2a और y = -2b रखने पर, हम प्राप्त करते हैं

(x/a) - (y/b) = 4

⇒ 2 + 2 = 4

⇒ 4 = 4

इस प्रकार, विकल्प (2) दोनों समीकरणों को संतुष्ट करता है।

∴ x और y के मान 2a और -2b हैं।

question:
Correct the following sentence:

I can't imagine why you were believing all those rumours since yesterday.
options: I can't imagine why wasn't you believing all those rumours since yesterday.
I can't imagine why you have been believing all those rumours since yesterday.
I can't imagine why you believed all those rumours since yesterday.
I can't imagine why do you believe all those rumours since yesterday.
solution:
Here the correct answer is I can't imagine why you have been believing all those rumours since yesterday.
Key Points:-
  • The above-given sentence should be in Present Perfect Continuous Tense because a point of time i.e. yesterday and been given which is preceded by 'since'.
  • Present Perfect Continuous Tense is used to express those actions that had begun in the past and are still in progress.
  • The structure of Present Perfect Continuous Tense is as follows:-
    • Subject + has/have + been + V1 + ing + Object + since/for + Time being(yesterday).
  • For Example - Ram has been living here since 1993.
  • Thus, the correct answer is Option 2.

Therefore, the correct sentence is I can't imagine why you have been believing all those rumours since yesterday.

question:
Correct the following sentence.

Each of the sports women were given a certificate.
options: Each of the sports women was given a certificate.
Sports women each were given a certificate.
Every sports women were given a certificate.
Each of the sports women have been given a certificate.
solution:
The correct answer is Each of the sports women was given a certificate.

Key Points    

  • The form of the verb ‘were’ is not correct in the sentence.
  • In the given sentence, the singular indefinite pronoun ‘Each’ is the subject and is singular and the verb ‘were’ is in plural form.
  • We know that a singular indefinite pronoun takes a singular verb.
  • Each is often followed by a prepositional phrase ending in a plural word (Each of the cars), thus confusing the verb choice. Each, too, is always singular and requires a singular verb.
  • Don't let the word "women" confuse you; the subject is each is always singular.
  • Thus, the singular verb 'was' should be used instead of "were".

​Correct Sentence: Each of the sports women was given a certificate.

  • The singular indefinite pronoun 'each' is used to refer to every one of two or more people or things, regarded and identified separately.
  • Singular indefinite pronouns take a singular verb; plural indefinite pronouns take a plural verb.
  • However, some indefinite pronouns can be singular in one context and plural in another.
    Eg: Here is some.
          Some have arrived.​

question:
Fill in the blanks with appropriate option.

The scheme allows students from many countries to communicate _______
solution:
The correct answer is with one another

Key Points

  • “Communicating to “ requires that a specific piece of information was conveyed to someone: “I communicated to the organization that the date had been changed to Wednesday.”
  • “Communicating with” is more open-ended, and does not require a specific fact to have been conveyed: “I have been communicating with the organization” or “I have been communicating with them about the date. Here we do not have specific fact to be conveyed, so 'communicating with' is preferable.
  • Each other is used when discussing two people or things, and one another is used when discussing more than two people or things.
  • Examples:
    • The twins told each other everything.
    • The triplets told one another everything. 

​Thus, the complete sentence is: The scheme allows students from many countries to communicate with one another.

question: An employment advertisement should _______ the number of vacancies.

question: The growing number of visitors _______ the footpaths.

question:

question: Ram was appointed ______ Clerk.

:-

question:

India is one of _______ biggest countries in the world.
solution:
The correct answer is 'the'. 

Key Points

  • The definite article 'the' is used before singular and plural nouns when the noun is specific or particular/ known to the reader.​
  • Superlative adjectives (biggest, largest, thinnest, smartest, etc.) are preceded by the definite article 'the' before them. 
  • Examples,

question: प्रति + उपकार = 'प्रत्युपकार' कौन सी संधि है?
solution:
प्रति + उपकार = प्रत्युपकार यण् संधि है जो इ + अ = य के संयोग से बना है। अन्य विकल्प असंगत है। अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प 4) यण ्संधि होगा ।

Key Points

स्वर संधि

संधि

परिभाषा

उदाहरण

यण संधि

इ, ई, उ, ऊ या ऋ का मेल यदि असमान स्वर से हो तो इ, ई का 'य'; उ, ऊ का 'व' और ऋ का 'र' हो जाता है।

जैसे - यदि + अपि (इ + अ) = यद्यपि, अनु + एषण = अन्वेषण।

 

अन्य विकल्प:-

स्वर संधि

संधि

परिभाषा

उदाहरण

दीर्घ संधि

जब दो शब्दों की संधि करते समय (अ, आ) के साथ (अ, आ) हो तो 'आ' बनता है, जब (इ, ई) के साथ (इ, ई) हो तो 'ई' बनता है, जब (उ, ऊ) के साथ (उ, ऊ) हो तो 'ऊ' बनता है।

जैसे – शिव + आलय (अ + आ) = शिवालय, गिरि + इन्द्र (इ + इ) = गिरीन्द्र।

गुण संधि

अ, आ के साथ इ, ई का मेल होने पर 'ए'; उ, ऊ का मेल होने पर 'ओ'; तथा ऋ का मेल होने पर 'अर्' हो जाता है।

जैसे – देव + इन्द्र (अ + इ) = देवेन्द्र, देव + ऋषि (अ + ऋ) = देवर्षि।

वृद्धि संधि

अ, आ का मेल ए, ऐ के साथ होने पर 'ऐ' तथा ओ, औ के साथ होने पर 'औ' में परिवर्तित हो जाता है।

जैसे – एक + एक (अ + ए) = एकैक, परम + ओजस्वी (अ + ओ) = परमौजस्वी।
